reviews.text: Haven’t used it yet, but based on the tester and the scent, can confirm that the product is very hydrating and almost scent-free, therefore has low irritant.
reviews.zh: 雖然仲未用過，但根據試用裝同氣味，可以確定產品非常保濕，而且幾乎冇香味，所以刺激性低。

reviews.text: I don’t think this product has made any difference in my skin. Might be better to use as a “mask” and let soak into the skin as opposed to just wiping the face. The packing is super neat though.
reviews.zh: 我唔覺得呢個產品對我嘅皮膚有任何分別。可能當作「面膜」咁用、等佢滲入皮膚，比起淨係抹面會好啲。不過包裝真係好整齊。

reviews.text: This product helps me a lot. Our whole family loves it. It's very moisturizing. I will repurchase again. Thank you so much.
reviews.zh: 呢個產品幫咗我好多。我全家都鍾意。非常保濕。我會再回購。非常感謝。

reviews.text: These toner pads are super moisturizing. Most toner pads I've used in the past dry up quickly but these stay wet for a while. They're mild and moisturizing. Totally recommend.
reviews.zh: 呢啲爽膚水棉片超級保濕。我之前用過嘅大部分爽膚水棉片都好快乾，但呢啲可以keep住濕潤一陣。溫和又保濕。完全推薦。

reviews.text:
A tip from me:
Put it in the fridge!!! 
It makes it a cooling toner pads that are good for depuffing the face in the morning before the make up
reviews.zh:
我嘅小貼士：
放入雪櫃！！！
咁就變成冰涼嘅爽膚水棉片，喺早上化妝前用嚟消面腫一流。

reviews.text: I love torriden products but this was really dull for me. The toner in the bottle works better in my opinion.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意Torriden嘅產品，但呢款對我嚟講真係好平平無奇。我覺得樽裝嘅爽膚水效果仲好。

reviews.text: Ahhhh! I love these pads so much. They have the perfect amount of essence and is literally the most cooling skincare product ever. It feels like ice on your skin it's seriously amazing I would totally recommend it lasts forever too.
reviews.zh: 啊啊啊！我好鍾意呢啲棉片。精華份量剛剛好，絕對係最冰涼嘅護膚品。感覺好似冰喺皮膚上面，真係勁正，我一定會推薦，而且用極都用唔晒。

reviews.text: Yes! I love these pads! I ordered serum from this brand and received 10 pads as a bonus and completely fell in love with it. That's why I have decided to order the full-size product. It delivers the moisturizing effect that my skin needs especially in cold and dry weather like now. The texture of the pad itself is very pleasant, and doesn't irritate my skin. The adhesion is great so you can easily use it as a spot mask if there is a need. For me it's a yes!
reviews.zh: 好！我好鍾意呢啲化妝棉！我買咗呢個品牌嘅精華，收咗 10 塊化妝棉做贈品，然後即刻愛上。所以我決定買正裝。佢做到我皮膚需要嘅保濕效果，尤其係而家呢種又冷又乾嘅天氣。化妝棉本身嘅質地好舒服，亦都唔會刺激到我塊皮膚。貼合度一流，如果有需要可以當成局部面膜用。對我嚟講就係要入手！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
